propositions: rebar comment accepts flag-like tokens (--body-file, --body) as the comment body instead of rejecting them, silently storing the flag string and discarding the intended content
the command exits 0 and produces a stored comment record when given a flag argument, masking the data loss from standard validation checks
a positional argument beginning with - is not rejected, violating the principle that ambiguous CLI input should fail loudly rather than coerce silently
the guard implementation covers comment, tag, untag, archive, and set-verify-commands commands via a reusable command table, preventing the same footgun across multiple commands
the -- escape hatch allows legitimate dash-prefixed values to be stored without triggering the rejection guard
